parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the information of all clusters that are deployed in a specific region, such as the cluster IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query all regions that are available for your account, such as the region IDs.

parameters.name: TDERegion
parameters.description: The region in which the TDE key resides.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb check-kms-authorized --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --tde-region cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
